outcome_note: A real Census 'Trade in Goods with Unidentified Countries' page exists and resolved HTTP 200 (verified by curl in the same tool call that saved the response). Available years on the page: 2016, 2014, 2013, 2012, 2011, ... 1992 (2015 and every year after 2016 are absent from the page's own year list; the series appears to have stopped being published after 2016). Since a real page with 2013-2016 data exists, this fixture records captured values in the same shape as the other four published-examples fixtures, not NOT_APPLICABLE. 2013 was chosen because it is SPEC's default START_YEAR and the earliest year most likely to be in configured_coverage for this pipeline.
